normalization: L2 normalized vectors so inner product equals cosine similarity.
main_result: Semantic and keyword search were compared with precision@5 over manually labeled AG News query intents.
interpretation: Semantic search shines on meaning-based queries such as technology company releases new security software, where it reached P@5=1.0 versus keyword P@5=0.8. Keyword search is sufficient or better when exact topical words are present, as shown by new satellite rocket launch space mission tying at P@5=1.0 and stock market and company earnings update favoring keyword search at 0.6 vs 0.4. Both methods averaged P@5=0.9, so semantic search is not universally better; it is strongest for paraphrase and concept matching, while keyword search is a cheap strong baseline for precise lexical queries.
